get.description: Retrieve the installer service account used for cluster installation.

post.summary: Mint a short-lived bootstrap JWT for the installer service account.
post.description:
Returns a 2-hour Keycloak access token for the cluster's dedicated
per-cluster installer service account, scoped to the given cluster.
Called by cluster-service when generating the cluster install command.
The token is passed to the Helm hook as
--set controlPlane.bootstrapToken=<token> and used directly as a Bearer token
to call GET /clusters/{uuid}/control-plane-config — the installer client
secret never leaves the server.

The per-cluster installer client is resolved (and, if needed,
self-healed by creating it) internally, so callers only need to say
which cluster the token is for.

post.description: Use this endpoint to obtain an access token. Compliant with standard OAuth2 protocol and supports the common OAuth2 grant types.

grant_type.description:
The OAuth2 grant type. Determines the authentication flow and which parameters are required:

`client_credentials` - Authenticate as a service account or user access key using clientId and clientSecret.

`password` - Authenticate as a local user using username and password.

`external_token_exchange` - Authenticate as a service account or user using a token issued by the configured identity provider (IdP) for a Run:ai token. Requires externalToken.

client_id.description: The client identifier for a service account or user access key. Required when using the client_credentials grant type. Must be used together with clientSecret.

client_secret.description: The client secret corresponding to the clientId. Required when using the client_credentials grant type. Must be used together with clientId.

username.description: The username of a local user account. Required when using the password grant type. Must be used together with password.

password.description: The password for the specified username. Required when using the password grant type. Must be used together with username.

external_token.description: A valid token issued by the identity provider (IdP) that is configured in NVIDIA Run:ai. Required when using the external_token_exchange grant type.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token used to obtain a new access token. Required only when using the refresh_token grant type.

code.description: Authorization code issued by the authorization server. Used in the authorization_code grant to exchange the code for an access token.

redirect_uri.description: The redirect URI used during the authorization request. Required for the authorization_code grant to validate the redirect destination.

code_verifier.description: PKCE code verifier. Required when the authorization code was requested with a code_challenge.

usersFilterBy.name: filterBy
usersFilterBy.description: Filter results by a parameter. Use the format field-name operator value. Operators are <= Less than or equal, >= Greater than or equal, =@ contains. Dates are in ISO 8601 timestamp format and available for operators <=, >= and ==.

SortOrder.name: sortOrder
SortOrder.description: Sort results in descending or ascending order.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: The offset of the first item returned in the collection.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: The maximum number of entries to return.

search.name: search
search.description: Filter results by a free text search.

usersMinimalFilterBy.name: filterBy
usersMinimalFilterBy.description:
Filter results by username. Use the format field-name operator value. Supported operators are == (exact match) and =@ (contains).
Multiple entries (up to 25) are allowed only with the == operator.

usersMinimalSearch.name: search
usersMinimalSearch.description: Filter results by a free text search across username, firstName and lastName (OR logic). Minimum 2 characters.

usersMinimalId.name: id
usersMinimalId.description: Bulk lookup by user IDs (comma-separated). Returns the matching users in addition to any results from `search` or `filterBy`. Up to 25 IDs per request.
